title: freeCodeCamp certifications
description: A free, self-paced coding curriculum with projects and certifications in web development, JavaScript, Python, data and more.

title: CS50x: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Harvard’s introduction to computer science, free online: lectures, problem sets and a final project. Certificate options are listed on the course site.

title: Cisco Networking Academy courses
description: Self-paced courses in networking, cybersecurity, programming and IT, many of them free, with digital badges on completion.
eligibility: Anyone with a free account. Some courses run through schools.

title: Kaggle Learn micro-courses
description: Short, free, hands-on courses in Python, machine learning, SQL, data visualisation and more, run in the browser.
eligibility: Anyone with a free Kaggle account.

title: Microsoft Learn training
description: Free learning paths and modules for Azure, AI, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 and developer tools. Certification exams are separate and usually paid.

title: GitHub Student Developer Pack
description: Free access to developer tools and services for verified students, including GitHub features and partner offers.
eligibility: Students verified through GitHub Education. Check the site for current rules.

title: Google Summer of Code
description: A global online programme where new contributors work on open source projects for 12+ weeks with mentors. Dates change every year.
eligibility: Age and eligibility rules apply: check the official site before applying.

title: Outreachy internships
description: Remote internships in open source and open science, supporting people underrepresented in tech. Application rounds open twice a year.
eligibility: See the applicant guide on the official site.
